items.creator: Helena Woods
items.title: Forever that person dancing while waiting in line
items.summary:
Forever that person dancing while waiting in line. 

Always the person shimmying in the grocery store or while walking across the street. 

Always bustin’ out a move while waiting for a flight. 

If I’m going to stand around, I might as well move my body and bring some happiness to everyone around me duh 🤷🏼‍♀️ 

If you want to be more confident in 2027, start dancing in public. It will make you more shameless. 

Dancing does not disturb the peace. 

It’s actually the best exercise and triggers dopamine. 

And it only brings smiles to people’s faces. I should know….I’ve been bringing joy to the world for years. 💃 🪩 

#helenawoodsdancemoves
